title: Shoalrun document sync snapshot, version 1
description: The current documents.sync.json producer contract. Resolve the companion manifest schema locally by its $id; schema identifiers do not imply hosted availability. Consumers retain their own baseline snapshots. Unknown properties are allowed for additive evolution.

buildId.description: Opaque identity shared with this publication's manifest and build-info.json.

metadataDigest.description: SHA-256 of canonical JSON of manifest top-level metadata, excluding documents, dependencies, and buildId. Object keys are recursively sorted; array order is preserved.

documents.description: Records sorted by the JSON tuple [id, channel, version, language]. That identity must be unique; check uniqueness separately.

digest.description: Required SHA-256 of the complete generated Markdown twin bytes; copied from its manifest record.

contentDigest.description: Opaque resolved article-content fingerprint copied from the manifest. Compare for article changes, not fetched-byte verification.

recordDigest.description: SHA-256 of canonical JSON of the entire corresponding manifest document record, including its metadata; not a hash of this trimmed sync record. Object keys are recursively sorted; array order is preserved.
